invariance_conclusion: Pearson r on log-transformed hysteresis areas is invariant to arbitrary multiplicative rescaling of current (a conductance-unit change maps to an additive shift in log-space, which Pearson r ignores). r=0.9875 is therefore unit-independent.

dimensionless_derivations.mycelium: I = g_max * w(V) * V   ;   V' = V/V_ref, I' = I/(g_max*V_ref)  ->  I' = w(v) * v,  dw/ds = (w_inf(v)-w)/tau_w'   where s = t/tau_w, tau_w' = 1.  Dimensionless hysteresis area A' = A/(g_max*V_ref^2). No physical constant remains; alpha identical.
dimensionless_derivations.memristor: I = v / R(x), R(x)=R_on*x+R_off*(1-x). Set r=R_off/R_on, v'=v/V_ref, i'=i*R_on/V_ref -> i' = v'/(x + r*(1-x)). dx/ds = k' * i', k'=k*V_ref*R_on. Only RATIO r=R_off/R_on matters; absolute Ohms vanish. Dimensionless loop area A' = A*R_on/V_ref^2. alpha identical.

note: Both models reduce to dimensionless forms governed only by ratios (R_off/R_on) or unit-removed constants; alpha (exponent) is a pure number.
